name: FocusTrail Columns — Drag Window
description: Keyboard-driven Miller-column file browser with natural multi-selection/deselection, preserved deep columns across menu reopen, smooth horizontal reveals, configurable Trash shortcut, previews, sorting, archive extraction, pinning, LRU cache, Places/Drives, and native multi-page preferences. Native GTK drag window for sending selected local files to other apps (Ctrl+Shift+D).
